notes: Modified cash basis audit. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p4, Total Governmental Funds); its Taxes, State receipts and Local receipts lines are split with the all-funds schedule's printed breakdown of the same lines (p8, General + Street columns; each ties exactly). Cash and fund balance: the statements print fund balances (259,273 / 266,276) and the cash/CD asset lines; no single governmental cash figure is printed, so cash fields are null and fund balances are filled. Business-type from the proprietary fund statement (p6-p7, Enterprise Fund, modified cash basis, ties to the government-wide statement p1-p2): Other income 11,471 split per p8/p1 into 5% gross in-lieu-of tax 9,276 and Miscellaneous 2,195; Debt issuance 300,000 is a special item on the government-wide statement (p2) and is business_type.debt_proceeds (the p8 schedule prints it among Utilities local receipts, so it is a revenue detail line there); sales tax refunds, debt issuance costs and debt service interest (printed negative in nonoperating) are disbursements (Utilities expenditures 566,316 p1/p9). Business reported receipts 542,114 = p8 Utilities total revenues incl. debt proceeds 300,000. Roll-forward: 822,364 + 242,114 - 566,316 + 300,000 = 798,162. Governmental capital outlay is in the General Fund with no printed function, labelled 'Capital Outlay'. Balance sheet: governmental from p3 (totals equal government-wide 266,276), business-type from p5; totals from p2. Detail from the all-funds schedule (p8-p9, General / Street / Utilities columns); the all-funds budget-and-actual schedule (p10) prints totals by function only and duplicates it, so not recorded. Read pages 1-10 of 10.
